meaning: To ask a mailing list to stop sending you messages.
clues: It is an action you can take on a message or sender.
It is a request you send to a mailing list, asking it to take you off.
Your email app may show it as a banner or a button when you open a message.
It removes your address from that list, but other messages may still arrive.
Its name starts with U and means to stop being signed up.
assumes: Blocking stops messages from a sender from reaching you
Reporting tells a service about a message or sender
Deleting removes a message from your mailbox

decoys.meaning: To stop a person or sender from contacting you through a service.
To tell an authority or service about something that may be wrong.
To remove something, such as a message or file.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try it with someone you trust. Open a message from a list you joined and look for its unsubscribe link.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Mail-order catalogs had a way to stop deliveries too. A clear request saved paper and time.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: If the message looks odd, do not click its link. Open the service yourself and change your choices there.
